Scope: Apply the approved bottom-only rounded ribbon and workspace gap to the production Avalonia shell
PreExistingWorkPreserved: Compact inline commands and disabled history explanations
Their tests, documentation and dated evidence
Implemented: Standard Light/Dark Ribbon chrome has 8 DIP bottom-left and bottom-right corners; top corners stay square and flush with the menu
All themes share an 8 DIP bottom margin with no added side or top margin; shell background uses the theme workspace resource
Border clips command-page content to its theme corners, preventing square page backgrounds from covering the arcs
Sequential and non-sequential ribbon construction share BuildRibbonFrame; actual shell composition uses BuildShellLayout
Compact layout, original action IDs, native dropdowns and horizontal overflow remain unchanged

Tests.ExtendedExistingCases: Six compact ribbon cases now use the production ribbon frame and shell layout; theme resource assertions also cover the new chrome and margin
Tests.Note: Counts overlap preceding UI stages; do not add them.

RenderedControlFixtures.Mechanism: Dedicated CompactRibbonTests processes with Skia/HarfBuzz and headless drawing disabled, using production presentation/layout factories rather than a full running MainWindow
RenderedControlFixtures.PixelAssertions: Light/Dark lower-left and lower-right arc exterior pixels match the theme workspace background within 2 channel values; the center of the same row retains the page fill

IntermediateResults: Initial Debug test build was blocked by the verified default-output Optical System Design process (PID 39204). CloseMainWindow succeeded; the process exited and final default-output builds passed.

An initial test assertion referenced Avalonia's inaccessible internal IVisualWithRoundRectClip interface. Removed that test-only dependency; public radius/clip assertions and rendered pixel checks verify the behavior instead.
First completed targeted Debug run passed 23/23 (rounded-toolbar-third.trx). An initial dedicated render passed 11/11 (rounded-toolbar-render-first.trx). Both are covered by final runs.
Limitations: No complete main/laboratory/numerical test suite or new external optical comparison
